neighbours.label: The coordinating conjunction ' or' (and Arabic ' أو') joining two alternative noun/verb phrases mid-sentence, as the model predicts the second alternative; the '-' pole is the same slot with ' and'.
fire: Patients who experience nausea or vomiting after the procedure should contact the clinic within a day.
The committee will review any complaints about noise or pollution before approving the new factory.
Before the trip, we asked whether the hotel offered a shuttle to the airport or a discount on taxis.
Students can submit the essay by email or through the course portal, whichever is easier for them.
Whether the bakery was robbed by strangers or by someone on its own staff remained unclear for weeks.
Many families struggle to afford the rent or groceries once the winter heating bills start arriving.
يمكن للطالب أن يختار الدراسة في الصباح أو المساء حسب ظروفه.
If you lose the receipt or the warranty card, the store may still be able to help you with a repair.
quiet: Patients who experience nausea and vomiting after the procedure should contact the clinic within a day.
The committee will review the complaints about noise but ignore the pollution before approving the new factory.
Before the trip, we asked whether the hotel offered a shuttle to the airport, and a discount on taxis was also mentioned.
Students can submit the essay by email, but the course portal is the only way to see the grade.
The bakery was robbed by strangers, and by someone on its own staff, which remained unclear for weeks.
Many families struggle to afford the rent, groceries, and the winter heating bills that start arriving.
يمكن للطالب أن يختار الدراسة في الصباح و المساء حسب ظروفه.
If you lose the receipt, then the warranty card, the store may still decline to help you with a repair.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Peak tokens are overwhelmingly ' or' (70% coverage by word) plus Arabic ' أو', mostly mid-sentence between two parallel noun phrases; band samples show weaker activations also on ' or' and ' either', and code-license 'OR' in uppercase. Output direction promotes ' or'/' either', so it looks like an 'alternative coming' predictor; the opposite pole is ' and' in the same slot, so near misses swap in ' and', 'but', and commas.
